sections.body: Dams. Barriers that store water, control floods, and generate hydropower.

sections.heading: In depth
sections.body: Dams impound rivers into reservoirs, smoothing seasonal flow into year-round supply. They generate hydropower and blunt floods, but trap sediment and block fish migration — trade-offs managed with fish ladders and environmental flows.

record_text:
Key points.
Dams. Barriers that store water, control floods, and generate hydropower.

In depth.
Dams impound rivers into reservoirs, smoothing seasonal flow into year-round supply. They generate hydropower and blunt floods, but trap sediment and block fish migration — trade-offs managed with fish ladders and environmental flows.
